root_cause_analysis: Round 20 eval failed during the memory prepass on case 24, C24_gmv_positive_spike. The deterministic run id mapping shows ptv-cycle-20260618-2358-round-4c1db5ea-r2 is the second attempt for that case under the -mem phase. Attempt 1 failed before execution with LLM_REQUIRED_UNAVAILABLE; attempt 2 parsed metric_id=gmv and executed through broad positive-anomaly discovery until trace seq=18. At seq=18, select_signal_element for signal_type=interaction and evidence_alias=E_select_ch_interaction executed two guarded SQL queries, but the tool returned a runtime/tool error result with declared_sql_count=0. RcaPlanExecutor compared the declared count with the authoritative sql_audit delta=2 and failed fast with TOOL_SQL_COUNT_MISMATCH. This is a tool/runtime accounting contract bug in the select_signal_element failure path after guarded SQL execution, likely around preserving sql_count when post-query persistence or selection handling fails. It is not an LLM-only issue and not an attribution/ranking failure because no E4 merge or E_rank was reached for C24.

proposed_fix.description: Preserve SQL accounting on every select_signal_element path after guarded SQL execution, especially runtime_error/persist_evidence failures for dynamic lane aliases such as E_select_ch_interaction. Add a regression that constructs a positive-anomaly broad plan with interaction selection and proves either successful E_select_ch_interaction persistence with declared sql_count=2 or an explicit typed tool error whose sql_count matches the audit delta. Keep fail-fast behavior; do not bypass the SQL audit gate.
proposed_fix.estimated_impact: Restores eval completion for C24 and any broad GMV positive/interaction lane that executes select_signal_element after prior lanes. It should unblock baseline scoring without changing ranking, discovery, or fallback behavior.

stall_reason: C24 did not fail in Round 19; the current failure category differs from the Round 19 FIX-I strategy-routing work and is a first observed select_signal_element interaction-lane SQL-count failure in this round.
